Isolated VM environment for running Claude Code and Codex

Usage: coop [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  up             Ensure an environment for a project directory exists and is running
  quickstart     One-shot: ensure default image, start an instance for cwd, launch Claude
  setup          Check prerequisites, install Firecracker, fetch kernel and build template rootfs
  devcontainer   Inspect devcontainer.json support without starting setup or a VM
  start          Restart a stopped VM
  shell          Open an interactive shell in the VM (or run a command non-interactively)
  claude         Launch Claude Code inside the VM (skips permissions by default)
  claude-agents  Open the Claude Code agent view inside the VM (`claude agents`)
  codex          Launch Codex inside the VM (bypasses the sandbox and approvals by default)
  stop           Gracefully stop the VM
  destroy        Stop and clean up instance resources (keeps template)
  list           List instances by name and state
  status         Show VM status
  agent          Manage the coding agents installed inside a VM
  model          Show or switch a VM's model backend (cloud vs. local)
  logs           Stream VM serial console logs
  push           Push local workspace into the running VM
  pull           Pull guest workspace to local directory
  exec           Run a command in the VM and return its output (non-interactive)
  editor         Open an editor (VS Code or Zed) connected to the guest VM
  ssh-config     Install a `coop-<name>` SSH alias for ad-hoc ssh/scp/rsync
  images         List or manage golden images
  resize         Resize a stopped instance's disk, memory, or vCPU count
  commit         Save a stopped instance's filesystem as a reusable image
  restore        Replace an instance's filesystem with an image's, in place
  profiles       List or inspect available profiles
  github         Manage GitHub PAT entries and VM assignments
  proxy          Manage the credential-injecting proxy (issue #411)
  validate       Validate configuration and check prerequisites
  init           Generate a starter config file at ~/.coop/config.toml
  update         Replace the running coop binary with the latest GitHub release
  uninstall      Remove the coop binary and (optionally) its data directories
  completions    Print a shell completion script (run `coop completions --help` for setup)
  help           Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --config <CONFIG>  Path to coop config file [default: /home/baseline/.coop/config.toml]
  -v, --verbose...       Increase verbosity
  -h, --help             Print help
  -V, --version          Print version
